name: reading-experience
description: Reusable browser-level check definitions for the five-story reading experience. Elara runs these as page checks against the loopback-only production server (npm start, http://127.0.0.1:3000). Every route is checked at each viewport: the skip-link keyboard flow, the server-rendered reading progress (exactly one aria-current link, the exact 'Story N of 5' position, the next-story cue or the story-five ending), the landmarks, evidence and citation rendering, and clean console, request and scroll behaviour. This file is data, not an executable test: npm run verify:reading (scripts/verify-reading.mjs) only checks that these definitions are complete, and it never launches a browser.

expectedTitleContains: How AI is expected to help medicine
Beyond cancer: AI and the other diseases
Longer lives: what the lifespan numbers mean

unverifiedGaps.check: Skip-link flow, progress rendering, zoom, reflow and navigation in native Safari on macOS and iOS (the documented supported browser, not WebKit in general).
unverifiedGaps.note: WebKit is not native Safari: a WebKit-engine result is not represented here as native Safari coverage.

unverifiedGaps.check: Screen reader navigation: landmark and heading structure, the skip link, and the reading-progress cue announced correctly with assistive technology.
200% page zoom: content stays readable, the skip link still reaches main, and no sideways scrolling appears at or beyond the viewport widths above.
Reflow at viewport widths and aspect ratios beyond the listed widths (320, 375, 768, 1280, 1920 px).

notes: Browser behaviour is exercised only by Elara page checks against the loopback production server; this file is data, not an executable test, and nothing in it runs under a Node script.
npm run verify:reading (scripts/verify-reading.mjs) is a Node-only completeness check of this definition file: it starts nothing, opens no socket, and never launches a browser.
No unverified gap above is marked as passed, and browser behaviour is not a completed WCAG 2.2 AA or cross-browser verification claim.
